findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_reference, get_formula, preview_calculator, list_sandbox, get_review_status · Private data: get_reference, preview_calculator, build_workspace_page, generate_fee_app, validate_build, create_skill, pull_skill_scaffold · Public sink: submit_for_review, calculate_section_32_split, calculate_burns_lien, calculate_slu_percent_from_rom, calculate_fee_split · Destructive: build_workspace_page, submit_for_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_reference, get_formula, preview_calculator, list_sandbox, get_review_status · Private data: get_reference, preview_calculator, build_workspace_page, generate_fee_app, validate_build, create_skill, pull_skill_scaffold · Public sink: submit_for_review, calculate_section_32_split, calculate_burns_lien, calculate_slu_percent_from_rom, calculate_fee_split · Destructive: build_workspace_page, submit_for_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
